title: Russian Dropping Jaw Dumplings
description: A unique twist on traditional dumplings, incorporating crunchy elements and a hint of Russian flair. This dish is sure to drop jaws with its bold flavors and satisfying textures.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and water, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a small spoonful of shredded cheese in the center of each dumpling wrapper.
Dip your finger in Russian vodka and run it along the edges of the dumpling wrapper.
Fold the dumpling wrapper in half to seal the filling inside.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add a tablespoon of oil.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with a side of crispy fried onions and tod sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
